overview_description.description:
Software development teams are only as good as their ability to rapidly comprehend and integrate the work of many different authors.

Primitive believes that collaboration and immersive visualization are the future of software development. The arrival of virtual reality has provided a tremendous new platform to visualize data and collaborate in advanced ways. The Primitive programming interface is taking advantage of everything that VR can offer while applying the best practices of software analysis tools.

Primitive turns the output of software analyses into interactive 3D structures that are displayed in immersive VR.
